cause: P103 restores original nt_inthk.c and deletes the protected DPMI #GP instruction-emulation path including virtual CLI/STI and port I/O. repair_constraints: Do not blindly restore every deleted decoder or remove CPU privilege checks. Recover the required DPMI host virtualization contract, including virtual interrupt state and I/O; validate actual DOS4GW startup. The isolated CLI/STI-only candidate advances beyond the hang but fails later at 033F:002672B4, so that candidate is insufficient and is not deployed.
scope_limit: Confirmed startup regression boundary; not gameplay or full guest compatibility acceptance.
